$comment: Graphics presets (ARCHITECTURE.md §6, the settings row; docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Graphics presets). Settings → Graphics's Preset slider runs through `presets` in order, cheapest first; moving it applies one, and any graphics setting changed by hand shows Custom. Each preset sets every field of the fixed vocabulary the loader knows (client/src/ui/graphicsPresets.ts `PRESET_FIELDS`), by name: `renderScale` one of shared/render/upscale.json's scales and `upscaler` one of its upscalers, `water` a Settings water tier of shared/look/watertiers.json (low/medium), `shadows` and `torchShadows` off/low/high, `shafts` off/low/high, `clouds` off/low/medium/high (High, the half-resolution volume, only on Ultra: over its GPU budget from above, docs/CLOUDS.md §8.3), `distanceM`/`pixelError`/`memoryMb` the detail sliders (a phone clamps them to its ranges). The cuts are ordered by GPU time saved per beauty lost, from the measured costs (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Cost profile and Water cost): the render scale first, then torch shadows, sun shadows, light shafts, clouds, and the draw distance last; water Medium (the whole look) is kept down to Medium, and Low and Mobile keep the see-through Low (blended with no scene copy, so no pass split on a phone's tile GPU; caustic lines on the water, one ripple layer, no land reflections or flow streaks; owner, 2026-11-07). `default` names the preset a new player starts on, per device.
